Food remains on the table; no hand socket, pickup, mouth transfer or put-down is used.
The original 4096 JPEG texture remains packed in the editable file. Engine FBX and Web GLB use derived 512 PNG.
Existing static Sit pose is preserved as source history; current seated animations use the calibrated 0.422 m support baseline.
